title: Proof corrections for printers and authors
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes two sets of symbols to be used in correcting proofs, one in the margin and the other at the place in the text where the correction is to be made. It also includes some recommendations for preparation of copy for the printer.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Guide for drafting and presentation of Indian Standards

clause_3_terminology: Proof corrections for printers and authors

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
